label: identify the actual assurance before measuring breach
explanation: Both require identifying what the words commit the speaker to. A medical guarantee and a chart about a different boat configuration should not be analyzed solely from disappointment.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 2–8. Open assigned page 2.
